ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels visible on the fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white patches are located on the distal portions of both lobes. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire visible boundary, most pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, dense clusters of raised, roughly circular high-contrast elements (barnacles) are concentrated at the extreme distal tips and along portions of the trailing edge on both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical dark linear disruptions are visible within the high-intensity white patch on the right lobe distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of acorn barnacles at the trailing edge tips and along the serrated boundary.
